overview_description.description:
“Miamin Systems Inc.”  is a global business transformation agency delivering innovation with a purpose. We enable clients to anticipate tomorrow’s trends and connect more directly with consumers across their digital touch points while optimizing time-to-market and ROI.

We are a network of more than 200 innovators, design thinkers, marketers, creatives and developers spanning 5 continents with offices in 3 countries (Dubai, United Arab Emirates| Bangalore, INDIA ).

While our expertise is in technology, marketing and experience design, our passion is in addressing transformational business challenges for our clients, including strategy consulting, service design, technology services, and optimization of business-critical digital platforms for multichannel e-commerce and marketing.

For more information, visit www.miamincorp.com

about_short_description.short_description: Miamin Corp is an information technology company that provides cyber security, network security, and cloud security solutions.

product.name: Cloud & Data Center
product.description: Miamin offers services to manage hybrid and multi-cloud environments, including application transformation and management, with a focus on minimizing cloud sprawl and enhancing predictability, visibility, and control.

product.name: Cloud Transformation Services
product.description: Miamin provides services to migrate and deploy applications to public, private, or hybrid clouds, including assessments, migration, architecture, and design and deployment services.

product.name: Digital Workplace
product.description: Miamin transforms traditional work environments into modern workplaces, improving user experience and accelerating communication and collaboration through responsive service desk support, device and application management, and cognitive virtual assistants.

product.name: Workplace Modernization Services
product.description: Miamin designs and delivers modern workplaces using tools and data-led insights to assess current digital workplace maturity and recommend tailored transformation approaches.

product.name: Enterprise Mobility Management
product.description: Miamin's service helps design, build, and manage mobile strategies, solutions, and policies, ensuring secure and efficient mobile device management.

product.name: M365 Lifecycle Support Services
product.description: Miamin provides managed services for Office 365, Windows 10, Enterprise Mobility, and Security, using a framework that includes advisory, automated administration, assurance, and adoption to enhance operational efficiency and productivity.
